module purpose: neorv32_hwspinlock maintains a 32-bit internal state vector addressed by bus_req_i.addr(6 downto 2); lower-window accesses update the selected bit with `not bus_req_i.rw`, and bus reads return either the selected bit or the whole vector. It also acknowledges each strobe and drives no error on bus_rsp_o.

use-case flows.value: selected addressed state bit updated with `not bus_req_i.rw` when `bus_req_i.stb='1'`, `bus_req_i.addr(7)='0'`, and the slot decode matches
on a read request, return either the selected state bit masked by the slot decode or the full 32-bit state vector
acknowledge each bus strobe and report no error
clear the state vector and force the response record to rsp_terminate_c while rstn_i='0'

conceptual assets.concept: 32 held one-bit states indexed by the bus address
conceptual assets.reasoning: Each generated register bit is cleared on reset (`lock_q(i) <= '0';`, lines 41-42) and, on a rising clk_i edge, a qualified lower-window access writes `not bus_req_i.rw` into the selected bit (lines 44-45). The read-out flow later returns either `lock_q and sel` or the whole `lock_q` on reads (lines 66-70). Integrity is established because corrupting these stored bits makes both the update rule and the reported state incorrect; availability is also established because the register retains its value between qualified updates and is reinitialized by rstn_i. `bus_req_i` and `bus_rsp_o` act as transport records here (request fields addr/stb/rw and response fields ack/err/data), so they are excluded as structural references and the internal register is the eligible primary asset.

conceptual assets.concept: Selection of which indexed state bit an access targets
conceptual assets.reasoning: The module computes a per-slot decode with `sel(i) <= '1' when (bus_req_i.addr(6 downto 2) = std_ulogic_vector(to_unsigned(i, 5))) else '0';` (line 51 within the generate at lines 35-36). That decision is then used in the lower-window update condition for `lock_q(i)` (lines 44-45) and in masked readback `lock_q and sel` (line 68). Integrity is established because a wrong decode changes or reports the wrong indexed state bit; availability is established because this combinational decode is produced from the presented address whenever the logic is evaluated. The consumed address is on the transport request record and is excluded, so the eligible realization is the internal decode signal.
